sceneConcept: A neatly groomed forty-five-year-old Chinese campus liaison stands alone against a transparent background. Short black hair greys at the temples, and brown eyes accompany a perfectly measured admissions-brochure smile. He wears a warm brown campus blazer over a pale blue collared shirt and charcoal sweater vest, black trousers, a simple belt and polished brown shoes. With practiced courtesy, both hands extend one plain white porcelain teacup on a matching saucer toward the viewer. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the gesture warm but standardized. Visual refresh: a warm brown cardigan over a pale shirt with relaxed trousers and a tea cup.
